hero.title: About {name}
hero.subtitle: A modern recipe sharing platform where home cooks come together to discover, create, and share delicious recipes.

intro.title: What is {name}?
intro.lead: {name} is a recipe sharing social platform inspired by the love of cooking and community. Named after the famous chef rat from Ratatouille, this platform embodies the belief that "anyone can cook" — and everyone has something delicious to share.
intro.body: Whether you're a beginner learning your first recipes or a seasoned home cook with family recipes passed down through generations, {name} provides a space to document, discover, and connect with fellow food enthusiasts.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to organize your recipes and connect with other food lovers.

shareRecipes.title: Share Recipes
shareRecipes.description: Create and share your favorite recipes with the community. Add photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions.

smartPantry.title: Smart Pantry
smartPantry.description: Track ingredients in your pantry and discover recipes you can make with what you already have.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Explore recipes from other home cooks. Filter by ingredients, cuisine, or dietary preferences.

saveFavorites.title: Save Favorites
saveFavorites.description: Save recipes you love to your profile for quick access anytime you need inspiration.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Follow your favorite home cooks, comment on recipes, and build a community around food.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share your culinary creations with friends and family through social features.

creator.title: Created By
creator.bio: Full-stack developer passionate about creating beautiful, functional web applications. {name} was built as a labor of love, combining a passion for technology and food.

error.title: Oops! Something went wrong
error.description: We encountered an unexpected error. Don't worry, our team has been notified and we're working on it.

notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.description: Sorry, we couldn't find the page you're looking for. It might have been moved or deleted.
notFound.hint: Lost? Try searching for recipes or exploring our community feed.

offline.title: You're Offline
offline.description: It looks like you've lost your internet connection. Some features may be unavailable until you're back online.
